anyOf.description: a secret read from the server environment; never a literal value

anyOf.description: allow self-registration (default true)

role.description: the field holding the user's role (default role)

signedInAt.description: a datetime field of the user schema stamped on every sign-in

url.description: production database URL; dev uses .iwc/dev.db (SQLite) unless set

title.description: title template; %s is the page title

mode.description: spa (default): internal links swap the page in place and keep the layout mounted; document: every link loads a new document

prefetch.description: fetch a screen when the pointer rests on its link (default true)

notFound.description: the ui file rendered for unknown routes

offline.description: offline data (iwc enable offline): stored screens and replies, a persistent queue of writes sent exactly once when the connection returns, conflict handling and sync status — on the web, Android and iOS

fallback.description: the screen shown offline for a screen that was never stored (default: a built-in one)

maxAge.description: how long a stored screen or reply may be shown (default 7d)

retry.description: attempts before a queued write is shown as failed (default 8, with backoff)

status.description: auto (default) shows the connection and sync status; none leaves it to the app (a button with action: sync opens the list)

css.description: CSS the route loads (shared stylesheet and page styles), gzip-compressed

html.description: the route's HTML without data (its static shell), gzip-compressed

enforce.description: warn (default) prints budget overruns; error fails iwc build

inlineStyles.description: the largest stylesheet (gzipped) written into the page on a first visit instead of linked, which saves a render-blocking request; 0B always links (default 8KB)

tasks.description: periodic work while the app is closed (Android WorkManager, iOS background app refresh)
